material.text: alleyway/add-tradingview-alerts-tool: Automated entry of TradingView alerts for bot trading tools such as 3Commas, Alertatron, CryptoHopper, etc.
type=plugin source=github:alleyway/add-tradingview-alerts-tool created=2020-09-28T10:15:55Z firstSeen=2026-11-13T19:35:16.451Z published=? maintainers=? repoId=299269406 stars=723 npm30d=?

1) Make sure you have node version 22.x installed

    node --version


2) Run the global installation command which will ask to install to a subdirectory called "tradingview-alerts-home"

    npx @alleyway/create-tradingview-alerts-home@latest



Need further assistance?

    Check the latest at https://github.com/alleyway/add-tradingview-alerts-tool
